section1.title: Introduction
section1.body: {{appName}} ("we", "our", "us") is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard information when you use our business management platform.

section2.title: Information We Collect
section2.intro: We collect information that you provide directly to us, including:

accountInfo.label: Account Information
accountInfo.detail: Name, email address, phone number, and professional details

usageData.label: Usage Data
usageData.detail: Actions taken within the platform, features used, and timestamps

businessData.label: Business Data
businessData.detail: Customers, invoices, products, and other ERP data you enter

cookies.label: Cookies
cookies.detail: Session tokens and preference cookies for authentication and settings

section3.title: How We Use Your Information
section3.purpose1: Provide, maintain, and improve the {{appName}} platform
section3.purpose2: Process transactions and send related information
section3.purpose3: Send technical notices, updates, and support messages
section3.purpose4: Comply with legal obligations and protect rights
section3.legalBasis: We process your data based on your consent, contractual necessity, and our legitimate interests in providing the service.

section4.title: Data Sharing
section4.body: We do not sell your personal data. We may share data with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating the platform, subject to confidentiality agreements. We may disclose data when required by law.

section5.title: Your Rights
section5.intro: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data:

access.label: Access
access.detail: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you

rectification.label: Rectification
rectification.detail: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data

erasure.label: Erasure
erasure.detail: Request deletion of your personal data under certain conditions

portability.label: Portability
portability.detail: Request transfer of your data in a machine-readable format

objection.label: Objection
objection.detail: Object to processing of your data for legitimate interests

section6.title: Data Retention
section6.body: We retain your data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services. Business records may be retained longer to comply with legal and fiscal obligations.

section7.title: Contact
section7.intro: For privacy-related questions or to exercise your rights, contact our Data Protection Officer at:
section7.cnil: If you are located in the EU, you have the right to lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority (e.g. CNIL in France).
